name: Communications Management Plan

blocks.text: Attach relevant communication diagrams or flowcharts.

notes: Landscape page. The Assumptions / Constraints table is a separate two-column table with its own four rows, not a second bank of the stakeholder table. The prose (Table 2.27) differs from the blank form: 'Stakeholder communication requirements' (form: Stakeholder), 'Method or media' (form: Method), 'Time frame and frequency' (form: Timing or Frequency), one element 'Communication constraints or assumptions' (form: separate Assumptions and Constraints columns, Assumptions first), and 'Glossary of common terminology' (form: Glossary of Terms or Acronyms). The blank form wins. Although the form is mostly tables, forms-index.md gives its kind as fields.
